title: ynh search <term> --format json
description:
Output of `ynh search <term> --format json`. Currently emits a bare array of search results — does not yet use the {capabilities, ynh_version, ...} envelope. Envelope retrofit is a separate, capabilities-bumping change tracked outside this plan.

To turn a result into an install argument, branch on from.type: for source, install repo directly; for registry, install repo and pass path as --path when present. Do not build one from id.

id.description: Canonical identifier, for display and deduplication. Host-prefixed for registry results (github.com/org/repo/name), local/<name> for results from a configured local source. NOT an installable argument: ynh install rejects a local/<name> id and asks for a filesystem path. To install a result, branch on from.type and use repo.

repo.description: Where the harness comes from, and the field to install with. For from.type=source this is a complete filesystem path to the harness directory, installable on its own. For from.type=registry this is the remote repository, and path may name a subdirectory inside it.

path.description: Subdirectory of repo holding the harness, for a registry repository containing several. Absent for local-source results, whose repo is already the harness directory. Pass it to ynh install as --path.

install.description: The complete first argument to `ynh install`, so a consumer needs no branching. For from.type=source this is repo, the harness directory. For from.type=registry this is id, the scheme-less canonical ref: the installer synthesises the clone URL from its first three segments, so a value carrying https:// would be cloned verbatim instead. That form also needs no registry lookup, so it works on a machine with different registries configured.
